Grounds and wellness

Common room

Parties by the fire, even in deep winter.

New

The heart of winter parties

Instead of a kitchenette and sofa, apartment no. 5 has a large common room. It comes into its own in winter and hard frost, when sitting on the terrace isn't possible. The room opens directly onto the covered outdoor terrace, so bigger events can use both.

  • Fireplace and seating for about 30 guests, tables included
  • Large LED TV
  • Bar with a two-tap beer dispenser (e.g. beer and lemonade)
  • Facilities for serving guests: cooker, fridge and washing machine
  • Direct access to the covered terrace
  • Fireplace; firewood is on the pile by the fire pit and included in the price

Ideal for office parties, birthdays, winter wedding receptions or watching sport together.
